svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 970 mm lengths of 50 x 3 mm aluminium flat bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Distances from the rear end; heights from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Idler axle holes: fourteen at 30 mm, then every 70 mm (to 940 mm),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm up. Size them to the rollers' spring axles (8.2 mm for 8 mm round

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: axles; for hex axles use a matching hex hole).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw holes: four 6.5 mm at 40, 340, 640 and 930 mm, 13 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two bars clamped together so every hole matches.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bar sits flat on the rail's inside wall, its bottom edge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm above the rail's underside, rear end 90 mm from the rail's rear

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end; four M6 button-head screws into rivet nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bars are parallel, 434 mm apart inside.
